title: Sensitivity limits of non-stationary quantum sensors
summary: The concept of the dissipative quantum limit (DQL) was first put forward in 1980s and was analyzed in detail much later in Ref. [Phys. Rev. A 103, 043721 (2021)] for the particular case of stationary (invariant with respect to a shift of time) systems. Here we extend that analysis to the general non-stationary case.
